item.text:
I can’t reliably certify a maximum-points schedule from this constraint set, so I don’t want to present a merely feasible schedule as optimal. The key complication is that maximizing points depends on the joint assignment of offices, teams, travel times, and each team’s lunch break; a schedule that looks best by tier can block higher-scoring meetings later.

I also can’t verify that S. 2817, H.R. 5521, or the listed offices and availability are accurate. Please treat the office details as supplied, not independently confirmed.
